title.fr: Des symboles sur le front de mer

summary.en: Skate along the waterfront with the officer. You stop at the marina, at Canada Place and at the cargo ship, and at each one you learn something about Canada's symbols and then answer questions about it.
summary.fr: Roulez en planche à roulettes le long du front de mer avec l'agent. Vous vous arrêtez à la marina, à Canada Place et au navire de charge; à chaque halte, vous apprenez une chose sur les symboles du Canada, puis vous répondez à des questions dessus.

text.en: That is all right. I will be here by the water when you are ready.
text.fr: C'est correct. Je serai ici, au bord de l'eau, quand vous voudrez.

text.en: There is plenty of time. Each stop on the waterfront is about Canada's symbols. Your task on the screen says what to do now.
text.fr: Vous avez tout votre temps. Chaque halte sur le front de mer porte sur les symboles du Canada. Votre mission à l'écran indique ce qu'il faut faire maintenant.

text.en: My police service, the courts and Parliament all work under the Crown. The Crown is a symbol of government in Canada.
text.fr: Mon service de police, les tribunaux et le Parlement relèvent tous de la Couronne. La Couronne est un symbole du gouvernement au Canada.

source.quote: The Crown is a symbol of government, including Parliament, the legislatures, the courts, police services and the Canadian Forces.

verification.evidence: THE CANADIAN CROWN … The Crown has been a symbol of the state in Canada for 400 years. … The Crown is a symbol of government, including Parliament, the legislatures, the courts, police services and the Canadian Forces.

text.en: You skated the whole waterfront with me, from the marina to Canada Place and on to the cargo ship. Three stops along the seawall, and the outing is over.
text.fr: Vous avez roulé sur tout le front de mer avec moi, de la marina à Canada Place, puis jusqu'au navire de charge. Trois haltes le long de la promenade, et la sortie est terminée.

prompt.en: Meet the officer on the seawall
prompt.fr: Retrouvez l'agent sur la promenade du bord de mer

text.en: Hello again. Different coast, same uniform. Welcome to the Vancouver waterfront.
text.fr: Rebonjour. Une autre côte, le même uniforme. Bienvenue sur le front de mer de Vancouver.

text.en: Canada has a motto in Latin, A Mari Usque Ad Mare. It means from sea to sea. The country took it after the First World War.
text.fr: Le Canada a une devise en latin, A Mari Usque Ad Mare. Elle signifie « d'un océan à l'autre ». Le pays l'a adoptée après la Première Guerre mondiale.

source.quote: As an expression of national pride after the First World War, Canada adopted an official coat of arms and a national motto, A Mari Usque Ad Mare, which in Latin means “from sea to sea.”

verification.evidence: COAT OF ARMS AND MOTTO … As an expression of national pride after the First World War, Canada adopted an official coat of arms and a national motto, A Mari Usque Ad Mare, which in Latin means “from sea to sea.”

text.en: The maple leaf is the country's best-known symbol. French Canadians took it up in the 1700s, and it has been on our uniforms since the 1850s.
text.fr: La feuille d'érable est le symbole le plus connu du pays. Les Canadiens français l'ont adoptée dans les années 1700, et elle est sur nos uniformes depuis les années 1850.

source.quote: The maple leaf is Canada’s best-known symbol. Maple leaves were adopted as a symbol by French-Canadians in the 1700s, have appeared on Canadian uniforms and insignia since the 1850s

verification.evidence: THE MAPLE LEAF … The maple leaf is Canada’s best-known symbol. Maple leaves were adopted as a symbol by French-Canadians in the 1700s, have appeared on Canadian uniforms and insignia since the 1850s, and are carved into the headstones of our fallen soldiers buried overseas and in Canada.

text.en: Now skate along the water with me. We stop three times, and I will ask you about each stop.
text.fr: Maintenant, roulez le long de l'eau avec moi. On s'arrête trois fois, et je vous poserai des questions à chaque halte.

text.en: Look at the flags on those boats. Not every one of them is the flag you already know.
text.fr: Regardez les drapeaux sur ces bateaux. Ils ne sont pas tous celui que vous connaissez déjà.

text.en: The Union Jack is Canada's official Royal Flag. The Canadian Red Ensign was the country's flag for about a hundred years.
text.fr: L'Union Jack est le drapeau royal officiel du Canada. Le Red Ensign canadien a été le drapeau du pays pendant une centaine d'années.

source.quote: The Union Jack is our official Royal Flag. The Canadian Red Ensign served as the Canadian flag for about 100 years.

verification.evidence: FLAGS IN CANADA … The Union Jack is our official Royal Flag. The Canadian Red Ensign served as the Canadian flag for about 100 years.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about our flags, emblems and sports
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur nos drapeaux, emblèmes et sports

text.en: This one flies the flag you do know. There is a second mark inside, on every piece of paper.
text.fr: Ici, on hisse le drapeau que vous connaissez. Il y a une deuxième marque à l'intérieur, sur chaque document.

text.en: Canada's coat of arms carries symbols of England, France, Scotland and Ireland, with red maple leaves. You will see it on dollar bills, on government papers and on public buildings.
text.fr: Les armoiries du Canada portent des symboles de l'Angleterre, de la France, de l'Écosse et de l'Irlande, avec des feuilles d'érable rouges. Vous les verrez sur les billets de banque, sur les documents du gouvernement et sur les édifices publics.

source.quote: The arms contain symbols of England, France, Scotland and Ireland as well as red maple leaves. Today the arms can be seen on dollar bills, government documents and public buildings.

verification.evidence: COAT OF ARMS AND MOTTO … The arms contain symbols of England, France, Scotland and Ireland as well as red maple leaves. Today the arms can be seen on dollar bills, government documents and public buildings.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about the flag and the Crown
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur le drapeau et la Couronne

prompt.en: Go on to the cargo ship

text.en: One last stop, at the big ship. This one is about you, and about the test you are studying for.
text.fr: Une dernière halte, au grand navire. Celle-ci vous concerne, et elle concerne l'examen que vous préparez.

text.en: The two official languages, English and French, are counted among this country's symbols. Most adults must show they know enough of one of them to become a citizen. People who apply at 55 or older do not have to.
text.fr: Les deux langues officielles, l'anglais et le français, comptent parmi les symboles du pays. La plupart des adultes doivent démontrer qu'ils en maîtrisent suffisamment une pour devenir citoyens. Les personnes qui font leur demande à 55 ans ou plus n'ont pas à le faire.

source.quote: English and French are the two official languages and are important symbols of identity. English speakers (Anglophones) and French speakers (Francophones) have lived together in partnership and creative tension for more than 300 years. You must have adequate knowledge of English or French to become a Canadian citizen. Adult applicants 55 years of age or over are exempted from this requirement.

verification.evidence: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people and are the country’s official languages. … English and French are the two official languages and are important symbols of identity. … You must have adequate knowledge of English or French to become a Canadian citizen. Adult applicants 55 years of age or over are exempted from this requirement.

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about Canada's symbols and languages
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur les symboles et les langues
